name: Suprabhata Seva
timing: Conducted daily around to 5:30 AM to 6:00 AM
description: The morning ritual performed to awaken the deity.

name: Nitya Abhishekam
timing: Conducted daily between 6:30 AM and 8:00 AM
description: The primary ritual where the Shiva Lingam is bathed with holy water, milk, and traditional offerings. Devotees can regularly request archana and abhishekam.

name: Nitya Archana & Harati
timing: Performed throughout the day for visiting devotees (08:00 AM to 11:15 AM & 04:00 PM to 07:30 PM)
description: Continuous short prayers, chantings of the deity's name, and light offerings performed by the temple priests.

name: Maha Mangala Harati
description: The grand noon closing prayer performed right before the main sanctum closes for afternoon resting hours.
